expected_findings.description: Final phase gets a breadcrumb in the live renderer but not in the log renderer; the parity invariant is undocumented and untested for terminal phases.
The depth-coupling invariant (top-level phases only) is implicit and not documented at the fragile callsite; should explicitly document the invariant.
Test does not advance the clock after restart_span, so it only verifies zero-delta at restart moment and does not verify that the new baseline t0 is used going forward.
int(elapsed) truncates elapsed time (e.g., 9.9s to 9s); consistent with other sites so there is no new inconsistency, but any future changes should be made uniformly across all three sites.
